offering_description.value: The company makes immune globulin therapies for patients who need treatment or prevention of certain diseases. Its plasma collection centers collect human plasma used to make medicines. It also provides contract manufacturing, filling, packaging and testing for clinical-stage and commercial biopharmaceutical clients.

quotes.quote: We offer a full suite of CDMO and contract manufacturing organization (CMO) opportunities. Partner with us for your clinical-stage or commercial aseptic filling, packaging requirements, and our unique good manufacturing practice (GMP) testing.
